decision.observation: Survey from the boulder base: a large dark dome boulder ahead-left, but open red sandy ground sweeps up on the right past some dry grass/kelp fronds, with the ridge and palms on the skyline above. Stamina full green, no blue.
decision.hypothesis: The walkable route goes up the open red sand on the right side of the dome, not over the dark boulder. Walking forward-right along that sand should gain ground.
decision.memory: Repeated pattern: the dark dome boulders are walls; the open red sand beside them is the path. Favor sand slopes flanking boulders over climbing the boulders.
